svg.aria-label: Animated video walkthrough of the Smart Life Planner web demo

g.text: Mobile ready
Menu button replaces the sidebar
Cards stack into a single column
Same data as the desktop view
01 Landing page
A live example plan shows if a trip fits the budget
02 Create account
Strength meter on the password, hashed storage
03 Destinations
Seasonal cost estimates for every destination
04 Plan a trip
Budget, travellers, dates and travel tier in one form
05 Review: over budget
Swat is short by PKR 68,380, with cost breakdown
06 Options that fit
Every option recalculated against its own budget
07 Trip confirmed
Exactly within budget, PDF report created
08 Monthly budget
Planned vs spent, overspending flags, expense log
09 PDF reports
Every report saved and ready to download again
10 Dashboard
Trips, budgets and reports at a glance
11 Mobile layout
Same app on a phone: stacked cards and menu button
